insights.title: Email is the most efficient channel but under-funded
insights.text: Email delivers ROAS 6.5x and the lowest CAC (€31) yet receives only 6% of total spend. Even accounting for its limited reach, shifting a further 10–15% of budget into email (lifecycle and re-engagement flows) is the highest-ROI reallocation available.

insights.title: Display is the weakest channel and loses money
insights.text: Display spend of €3,660 returned €3,070 (ROAS 0.84x, CAC €159 vs. blended €66). CTR is 1.6% and click-to-conversion only 16%. Recommend pausing prospecting display and keeping only retargeting placements.

insights.title: Diminishing returns: spend elasticity of ROAS ≈ -0.71
insights.text: Across 120 campaigns, a 2x increase in spend per reached customer lowers ROAS by ~39%. Several large Social and Search campaigns are past the efficient frontier; splitting them into smaller, better-targeted flights would recover efficiency.

insights.title: Q4 seasonality is worth 1.4x an average month
insights.text: November–December revenue averages 1.4x the rest of the year while spend rises far less. Budget phasing should front-load Q4 and reduce July–August activity, where response rates hit the annual low.

insights.title: Loyal customers on desktop are the most responsive audience
insights.text: Loyal customers respond at 18.7% vs. 3.2% for At-Risk; desktop responds at 14.6% vs. 9.5% on mobile. Retention & Cross-sell campaigns average ROAS 4.5x vs. 2.7x for Acquisition — the CRM base is the cheapest growth lever.
